sentences.en: Even Chinese dignitaries were invited to visit the monument.
sentences.zh: 即使是中方的高级官员也被邀请参观这座纪念碑。

sentences.en: When I fart and the dignitaries begin laughing at me, draw your swords.
sentences.zh: 当我放屁而那些贵宾开始笑我时，拔出你的剑来。

sentences.en: The dignitary drove a very fancy car.
sentences.zh: 那位贵宾开了一辆非常豪华的轿车。

senses.zh: 高僧,高官,显要人物adj.高官的,权贵的
